# Union-interval busy redefinition (dispatch → finish)

## Summary

Redefine `Local model utilization` busy time as the union of `dispatch → finish` intervals (prefill + decode), retaining the decode-only figure as a separate row. Label lower/upper bounds. Keep existing fast/cheap bucketing and concurrency stats working on the new intervals.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `Local model utilization` reports `busy` as the **union of dispatch → finish intervals** (prefill + decode), using `ttft_event.ts - ttft_ms/1000` as the interval start.
- The **decode-only figure is retained alongside as a separate row** (`decode_busy_seconds`, the union of `Stream started` → `Stream finished`), and the report carries a **labelled lower/upper bound** for the busy figure.
- The busy definition change is stated explicitly in the section header: busy = at least one local slot active from dispatch to finish (prefill + decode).
- Existing **fast/cheap bucketing and concurrency stats keep working on the new intervals**: `fast_busy_seconds`, `cheap_busy_seconds`, `hourly_busy`, `avg_concurrency`, `peak_concurrency` and `total_compute_seconds` are all recomputed on dispatch→finish.
- Streams without a TTFT event fall back to `[stream_started_ts, finish_ts]` and are attributed to the lower bound, so the busy figure is never overstated.
- Unit tests verify the union of dispatch→finish intervals including boundary-crossing and unfinished streams, that the decode-only figure is retained, and that overlapping prefill+decode intervals merge correctly.

## Key Files

- `scripts/aggregation.py`
- `scripts/reporting.py`
- `tests/test_analyze_proxy_usage.py`

## Dependencies

- LP-0MVJN45LF009CO2V (prefill interval model)

data.description:
## Goal

Add failing-first regression tests that reproduce the 2026-10-22 Web UI freeze
root cause (parent LP-0MVJML600003CQ6Y): a `/slots` single-flight **leader**
cancelled mid-fetch leaves its shared future pending, so every **follower**
awaiting that future hangs forever.

These tests must FAIL against the current implementation and PASS once
LP-0MVJML600003CQ6Y child "Resolve orphaned single-flight future on leader
cancellation" lands. All 8 existing tests in the file are happy-path / TTL /
backoff only and do not exercise either cancellation path.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: A follower awaiting an in-flight `/slots` fetch is released when the leader is cancelled (`asyncio.CancelledError`), rather than blocking forever; the test cancels the leader task mid-fetch while a follower is already awaiting the shared future and asserts the follower completes within a bounded in-test deadline (< 5 s) and that `_slots_poll_inflight` is empty afterwards.
- AC2: A follower never waits unboundedly — if the leader disappears without resolving the future, the follower either re-fetches as a new leader (a second upstream call is observed) or returns the last-known/cached values within its own timeout.
- AC3: Cancelling a request that owns the single-flight fetch does not leak a pending future or emit "Future exception was never retrieved" / "Task was destroyed but it is pending" warnings; the test asserts this via `caplog` / asyncio debug mode.
- AC4: The documented reproduction fails before the fix and passes after it, using the existing test-skill runner (no ad-hoc pytest invocations); this item records the pre-fix FAIL output in a comment and keeps the pre-existing 8 coalescing tests green (the post-fix pass is recorded on LP-0MVK1YDKB0009HTM).

## Approach (smallest end-to-end slice)

- Extend `proxy/tests/test_slots_poll_coalescing.py` with a cancellation section
  reusing the existing `_CountingClient` / `_fresh_cache` fixtures.
- Stub the slow upstream with a client whose `get()` awaits a long
  `asyncio.sleep` (as in the reproduction recorded on the parent item).
- Structure each test as: start leader task → wait until the leader has
  registered the inflight future → start follower(s) → cancel the leader →
  assert follower completion inside `asyncio.wait_for`.

Out of scope: production code changes (the fix child owns those).

## Key Files

- `proxy/tests/test_slots_poll_coalescing.py` — add the cancellation regression tests.
- `proxy/proxy/observability.py` — `_fetch_slots_payload()` / `_slots_poll_inflight` under test (read-only here).
